calls.statement:
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, MIN(calendar_date) AS quarter_start, MAX(calendar_date) AS quarter_end
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter
ORDER BY fiscal_quarter

SELECT 
  f.product_key,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_net_sales,
  SUM(f.standard_cost) AS total_standard_cost,
  SUM(f.net_amount) - SUM(f.standard_cost) AS gross_margin,
  ROUND((SUM(f.net_amount) - SUM(f.standard_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS margin_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
  AND s.region = 'South'
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY f.product_key, p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  f.product_key,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_net_sales,
  SUM(f.standard_cost) AS total_standard_cost,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS total_returns_refunded,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.standard_cost_returned), 0) AS total_cost_returned,
  (SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0)) - (SUM(f.standard_cost) - COALESCE(SUM(r.standard_cost_returned), 0)) AS gross_margin_net_of_returns
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id AND r.return_date >= '2025-01-27' AND r.return_date <= '2025-04-27'
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
  AND s.region = 'South'
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY f.product_key, p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY (SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0)) - (SUM(f.standard_cost) - COALESCE(SUM(r.standard_cost_returned), 0)) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  COUNT(f.sales_line_id) AS sales_lines,
  COUNT(r.return_line_id) AS returns,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_items
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id AND r.return_date >= '2025-01-27' AND r.return_date <= '2025-04-27'
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
  AND s.region = 'South'
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE

SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0), 2) AS net_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(f.standard_cost) - COALESCE(SUM(r.standard_cost_returned), 0), 2) AS cost_of_goods,
  ROUND((SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0)) - (SUM(f.standard_cost) - COALESCE(SUM(r.standard_cost_returned), 0)), 2) AS gross_margin
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id AND r.return_date >= '2025-01-27' AND r.return_date <= '2025-04-27'
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
  AND s.region = 'South'
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 10
